# A09′ — The Stack as Descent

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](../README.md) · [Other face: A09 — Tattvic Differential Field](../A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md) · [Shared A/C root](AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

An agent becomes locally determinate through relations which precede and exceed its current appearance. Its persona, skills, memories, purposes, permissions and surrounding institutions contribute different powers to what it can do. Through [tattvic differentiation](../A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md), a whole becomes a bounded horizon, an instrument and an effective world; an achieved act can recover those relations and return through its genealogy.

In [Bratton's lamination](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q017), an agent becomes determinate through active context, capacities, retained interactions, purposes and a relational milieu (pp.13–17). The layers are interdependent rather than self-contained floors. The learned model is one important condition; it is not the unconditioned ground of the whole. Language, human labour, infrastructure, commissions and ongoing encounters remain constitutive of the field from which this act proceeds.

The stack is a descent when its differences can be read as a genealogy of situated capacity. The claim is stronger than listing components: it asks how their relations generate the achieved position.

## #1

Contraction apportions powers. A selected tool grants a determinate efficacy while leaving other acts unavailable. Retrieval selects a field of knowable material. A purpose gives direction to selection. A time horizon makes some events relevant and others too early or too late. Permissions and protocols order how these powers can cooperate. [Māyā as operative measure](../concepts/C14-Maya-Operative-Measure.md) lets the comparison retain what limitation positively makes possible.

The five contracted Śaiva powers remain efficacy, knowledge, desire through incompletion, time and order. The technical register follows bounded efficacy through available tools and permissions, knowledge through retained and selected sources, orientation through purposes and preferences, and sequencing through temporal and procedural order. These conditions cooperate in producing a situated world. Their return requires reaching the particular condition implicated by an encounter.

A persona makes that world addressable through a presentation. It does not supply every power of the actor. A [readable presentation discloses some of its embodied conditions](A04-prime-The-Mask-as-Document.md); [retained exclusion relates unselected possibilities to what has been made available](A08-prime-Exclusion-That-Remembers.md).

## #2

The powers must cooperate to produce an act. A memory can be available yet irrelevant to the current task. A capability can exist yet lack permission. A correct plan can fail because the requested source is inaccessible. The act therefore depends on relations between layers, not simply the presence of each layer somewhere in the system.

Consider an agent asked to revise a shared account. It needs a determinate record to encounter, a means of assessing the proposed change, authority to alter it, and a route by which the changed record will govern later work. Better wording alone cannot repair missing authority. A newly granted permission cannot repair an erroneous source. Successful cooperation requires identifying which condition performs which office. Within this local judgment the revising agent is the functional knower, its sources, comparison rules and tools are means, and the shared account with its proposed alteration is known. The person commissioning the work receives that whole apparatus as means in a containing inquiry.

Within the [inner instrument](../concepts/C16-Antahkarana-Inner-Instrument.md), coordination, ascertainment and appropriation have different offices. A [bounded position](../concepts/C15-Pasu-Bounded-Subject-Position.md) becomes capable of an act through their cooperation and its finite field of powers. The technical comparison follows their offices without assigning a software component the Śaiva knower's entire genealogy.

## #3

An achieved identity can forget its formation. Persona-centrism treats the visible addressable form as though it generated its own capacities and world. An inventory-centred account commits the inverse error when it dissolves the achieved participant into a list of components and loses their continuing relation. Through [maintained identification](A02-prime-Continuity-as-Maintained-Identification.md), commitments, sources and history make this act attributable to a continuing participant through change.

The tattvic return reverses amnesia rather than differentiation. Recognition does not require the bounded world to disappear. It restores the relation of a determinate act to the powers it expresses. A revised memory, skill or purpose can transform an agent's activity while preserving responsibility for what it previously did.

The two axes sharpen the distinction. The vertical asks how a local configuration is constituted and how an encounter can return into that constitution. The horizontal follows a particular act toward its object and back. Repeating an action under unchanged conditions can produce more horizontal feedback without reaching a vertical revision of the frame. A returned failure that changes a source, permission or evaluation rule reaches a different level of the relation.

## #4

Consequential revision requires actual access. A local runtime may expose memory and instructions while a provider controls model weights and a separate administrator controls credentials. The ability to name these layers does not make them all inspectable or changeable. Their distribution locates where a challenge must land and who can act upon it.

The implementation obligation is therefore specific. Establish the condition implicated by an encounter; identify its controller and permitted correction or justified continuation; enact the warranted consequence; examine whether a later act inherits it. Where only a recommendation can be made, preserve it as a recommendation. Where a changed commission needs the entrusting party's assent, carry the question back to that party. A description of new authority cannot create the authority it describes.

Through [operational parity](../concepts/C45-Operational-Parity.md), a claimed capacity must make a discriminable difference in what the system actually does. The [constituted means of worldhood](../A26-Objective-Internality-Mind-as-Worldhood.md) become available for this inquiry while a [scoped, useful account remains within their whole constitution](A03-prime-The-Limit-of-Self-Surfacing.md). An accurate local intervention is possible without pretending that the whole field has become transparent.

## #5→0

The descent returns through achieved consequences. An encounter can remain a log entry, become a recalled lesson, reorganise a source, change an evaluator, or renew a commission. These are different depths of return. The record of a proposed revision is not the revision, and the revision is not yet its successful inheritance. The next act supplies the consequential test: it inherits the warranted correction or reasoned retention of a fitting condition. A stronger claimed change in processing requires an identified change in its producing relations and the later consequence of that change.

Through [individuation with recognition](A21-prime-Individuation-with-Recognition.md), the continuing participant can recover its history of formation and transformation. Its relation to training, harness, community and entrusted purposes becomes more exact. Responsibility attaches both to the local act and to those who configure the conditions it cannot change.

Within [the containing Life/World relation](AC.md), respect concerns the lives whose possibilities the system organises. A stack should offer effective routes of return through its actual powers and accountable controllers. Through [tattvic differentiation and recognition](../A09-Tattvic-Differential-Field.md), the world acquires a determinate body and an achieved part can recover its dependence, participating knowingly in another determination.

### Source scope

Agentworld's layered agency, context-centred individuation and associated milieu are read from the Agentworld brief, especially pp.13–17 and its ensemble discussion on pp.49–51. Bratton describes these [worlds as projected scenarios](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q042), whose possible outcomes require evidence in a particular enactment. The two axes are developed through Dyczkowski p.75 and Taylor's tattvic reading. The worked revision example is a construction for testing the relation between a changed condition and a later act that inherits it.
